reference_policy: Frozen numerical Kerr220 from completed A2/A4; no tuning to new wave data
fit_model: C exp[(-alpha - i omega)(t-t0)]; same unweighted complex RSS for both models; C analytic projection; free omega and alpha bounded positive
BIC_policy: Report N_real=2*N and k=2 vs 4 diagnostic only; correlated residuals and no error model preclude calibrated model odds or GR test. No new residual threshold added after viewing results.
holdout_r40: Train first 2/3 of third period, predict remaining 1/3 with no refitting
additional_checks: same-age complex shape r15/r30/r40 third period
m=-2 versus conjugate m=2 on primary windows
exclusions: no repetition of five-radius travel-time or 1/r audits
no physical inference of additional dimensions from residuals
